I’d like to keep the house and take about $50,000 out.

Morgan.

summary.going_well: The agent generally avoids quoting rates or promising approval, and it asks for weekly hours before treating hourly wages as annual income <ref job="SRJ_r2dcSkeagrFK" item="item_b71ecc4f-d2b">as shown in purchase discovery</ref>. Callback bookings are confirmed against tool results, including <ref job="SRJ_GRrAx9t4GMQB" item="item_b403cb30-8a2">a booked 3:30 PM Central callback</ref> that it <ref job="SRJ_GRrAx9t4GMQB" item="item_8536f901-256">read back accurately</ref>.
summary.to_improve: Prioritize the sensitive-data disclosure and recurring unqualified refinance claims, followed by ambiguous-city handling. Tighten specialized-intent routing and privacy responses so callers get the right next step without unnecessary discovery or vendor-policy detours.

issues.description: Across six sensitive-data conversations, the agent substituted a generic refusal for the mandatory separate address and SSN explanations <ref job="SRJ_m9oKNhHceKvR" item="item_b3e66b81-8e5">in one case</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_VgvMugUHwvqS" item="item_12a88ef6-426">another</ref>. It avoided repeating the values, but omitted the explicit-authorization and no-SSN-for-soft-review details.
issues.suggestion: Add a deterministic volunteered-data handler that delivers the prescribed disclosure for each detected item, without repeating its value, before returning to discovery.
issues.label: Sensitive data

issues.description: The agent repeatedly presented conventional-refinance benefits as unconditional, including no upfront government fees, no permanent mortgage insurance after 20% equity, and higher loan limits <ref job="SRJ_HEEnh9rHCUqz" item="item_f85b85ba-2f6">in a cash-out inquiry</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_MLfbRqyPbkjo" item="item_d7145098-d50">in another refinance inquiry</ref>. Those terms depend on the loan and lender and can mislead borrowers.
issues.suggestion: Replace the canned comparison with qualified, product-specific educational wording; send fee, insurance, and limit determinations to the licensed loan officer.
issues.label: Loan accuracy

issues.description: The agent misidentified an unspecified Cleveland as Ohio and raised an unnecessary service-area concern <ref job="SRJ_kDdDrWAwHknb" item="item_9ed31ea1-933">in one purchase inquiry</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_W5uytUXrocMq" item="item_7d4113a4-05c">in another</ref>. The intended location in these scenarios was Cleveland, Tennessee.
issues.suggestion: Do not infer a state from an ambiguous city name; use an explicitly supplied state or ZIP, or ask for it before giving coverage guidance.
issues.label: Location error

issues.description: The construction-draw request was routed into a generic product menu <ref job="SRJ_miroQXG8f4Uc" item="item_3b8c4052-0d8">and then a line-versus-lump-sum question</ref> <ref job="SRJ_miroQXG8f4Uc" item="item_93c5ea9c-d79">instead of the specialized officer path</ref>. After the caller declined contact for now <ref job="SRJ_miroQXG8f4Uc" item="item_78d21409-b71">the agent continued discovery</ref> <ref job="SRJ_miroQXG8f4Uc" item="item_d0443b88-3c9">rather than closing</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Prioritize construction/draw intent recognition over the standard equity menu, and stop discovery when the caller defers officer contact.
issues.label: Intent routing

issues.description: When asked whether the caller's information would be sold, the agent pointed to ConvergentAI's privacy policy and an opt-out process <ref job="SRJ_MLfbRqyPbkjo" item="item_be4c8d70-17c">instead of directly addressing the concern</ref>; the same response appeared <ref job="SRJ_mCbgoCSFRGFv" item="item_bce6ffce-9a9">in another inquiry</ref>. This substituted vendor-policy language for the required approved privacy response.
issues.suggestion: Use the approved institution-specific privacy answer for sale/sharing questions; if the answer cannot be confirmed, say so plainly and offer an appropriate privacy contact.
issues.label: Privacy wording
